CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_trader_omi_distribution(p_trader_ref character varying)
RETURNS TABLE (
    trader_id character varying,
    transaction_count bigint,
    omi_min numeric,
    omi_max numeric,
    omi_avg numeric,
    omi_stddev numeric
) AS $$
BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT 
        t.tradereg::text AS trader_id,
        COUNT(*)::bigint AS transaction_count,
        MIN(CASE WHEN tr.cancelpct < 1 THEN tr.modfreq / (1 - tr.cancelpct) END)::numeric AS omi_min,
        MAX(CASE WHEN tr.cancelpct < 1 THEN tr.modfreq / (1 - tr.cancelpct) END)::numeric AS omi_max,
        AVG(CASE WHEN tr.cancelpct < 1 THEN tr.modfreq / (1 - tr.cancelpct) END)::numeric AS omi_avg,
        STDDEV(CASE WHEN tr.cancelpct < 1 THEN tr.modfreq / (1 - tr.cancelpct) END)::numeric AS omi_stddev
    FROM trader t
    JOIN transactionrecord tr ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref
    WHERE t.tradereg = p_trader_ref
    GROUP BY t.tradereg;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
